# Barangay Boundaries Repository

> Curated hierarchical Philippine administrative boundaries as per-class GeoJSON (barangays,
> municipalities, cities split by legal class, provinces, regions, special geographic areas), each
> polygon annotated with its canonical Philippine Standard Geographic Code (PSGC). Derived from PSA
> PSGC snapshots and NAMRIA administrative-boundary shapefiles (v2023-11-06). Includes a quarterly
> PSGC change history published as W3C ORG RDF linked data across 17 snapshots (2021-08-19 to
> 2026-04-13).

The curated end product is the **hierarchical per-class GeoJSON** collection. The `enriched`
(`adm0`–`adm4`) and `raw` NAMRIA-converted files are intermediate pipeline stages kept for
traceability. Per-class files are downloadable individually from the GitHub Release for the
`v2023-10-24` snapshot; replace the tag to target another snapshot.

Base release URL: https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/releases/download/v2023-10-24/

## Curated hierarchical per-class GeoJSON (recommended)

- [barangays.geojson](https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/releases/download/v2023-10-24/barangays.geojson): all ~42,000 barangay polygons (ADM4), PSGC-tagged
- [municipalities.geojson](https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/releases/download/v2023-10-24/municipalities.geojson): 1,485 municipalities
- [provinces.geojson](https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/releases/download/v2023-10-24/provinces.geojson): 82 provinces
- [regions.geojson](https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/releases/download/v2023-10-24/regions.geojson): 17 regions
- [highly_urbanized_cities.geojson](https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/releases/download/v2023-10-24/highly_urbanized_cities.geojson): 34 HUCs
- [independent_component_cities.geojson](https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/releases/download/v2023-10-24/independent_component_cities.geojson): 6 ICCs
- [component_cities.geojson](https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/releases/download/v2023-10-24/component_cities.geojson): 110 component cities
- [special_geographic_areas.geojson](https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/releases/download/v2023-10-24/special_geographic_areas.geojson): 9 special geographic areas
- [submunicipalities.geojson](https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/releases/download/v2023-10-24/submunicipalities.geojson): Manila submunicipalities (empty — no NAMRIA polygons)
- [country.geojson](https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/releases/download/v2023-10-24/country.geojson): national boundary (ADM0)
- [non_administrative.geojson](https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/releases/download/v2023-10-24/non_administrative.geojson): features that did not map to a standard PSGC level
- [unresolved.geojson](https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/releases/download/v2023-10-24/unresolved.geojson): features that could not be matched to a PSGC entity
- [classification_report.json](https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/releases/download/v2023-10-24/classification_report.json): per-class feature counts and classification details
- [summary.md](https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/releases/download/v2023-10-24/summary.md): human-readable classification summary with coverage gaps and known limitations

## Bundle + checksums

- [barangay-boundaries-2023-10-24-hierarchical.zip](https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/releases/download/v2023-10-24/barangay-boundaries-2023-10-24-hierarchical.zip): all per-class GeoJSON in one zip
- [manifest.json](https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/releases/download/v2023-10-24/manifest.json): per-file MD5 / SHA-256 / size / feature count

## Intermediate pipeline stages (in-repo only)

- Enriched (`adm0`–`adm4.geojson`, PSGC-annotated, pre-classification):
  https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/tree/main/2023-10-24/enriched_t0p005
- Raw (NAMRIA-converted, pre-enrichment):
  https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/tree/main/2023-10-24/raw_t0p005

## PSGC change-history RDF (per snapshot)

- https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository (delta.ttl / .nt / .jsonld under each YYYY-MM-DD/ snapshot dir)

## Per-feature properties

Each GeoJSON feature carries: `psgc_id` (stable entity URI), `psgc_code` (10-digit PSGC),
`psgc_name`, `psgc_status` (e.g. `existing`), `match_confidence` (`exact` | `huc_map` | `fuzzy`),
plus the original NAMRIA attributes (e.g. `ADM4_EN`, `ADM4_PCODE`).

## Architecture & references

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/blob/main/AGENTS.md): full architecture, pipelines, CLI commands, file map
- [PSGC code structure](https://bendlikeabamboo.github.io/barangay-boundaries-repository/psgc/): 10-digit hierarchical code breakdown
- [HUC mapping](https://bendlikeabamboo.github.io/barangay-boundaries-repository/huc-mapping/): resolving the Highly-Urbanized-City / NAMRIA-province mismatch
- [Data overview](https://bendlikeabamboo.github.io/barangay-boundaries-repository/data/)
- [Releases](https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/releases)
